Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

npcompete (development version)

Documentation

  • New README with a metrics overview, quick start, market definitions and the data included.
  • Articles for each metric (HHI and NHHI, concentration ratios, Kwoka, Gini, scale-free density), each with descriptive statistics and plots by NTEE major group and metro size, plus an article on how the metrics correlate, with principal components and factor analysis.
  • New dataset cbsa_metrics: every metric for every US metro and micro area in 2019, by subsector, on total revenue.
  • Added this changelog.

Live NCCS source (Phase 4)

  • source = "nccs" in npc_get_orgs() and npc_build_metrics() builds from NCCS downloads instead of the local archive. npc_build_nccs() downloads the CORE 990combined files and the unified geocoded BMF, harmonizes them to the archive’s layout (npc_standardize(source = "nccs_core")) and caches them under npc_cache_dir(). Missing years are built on demand.
  • Tax years follow the SOI convention (the year the fiscal period began), so tax year t combines CORE files t and t + 1. A year whose t + 1 file is still partial is flagged incomplete.
  • npc_nccs_download() caches files with retries and logs URL, size and MD5 in downloads.csv; year-counts.csv and manifest.csv record the CORE files and BMF used for each year.
  • npc_match_county() matches geocoded county names to FIPS codes, including parishes, boroughs and independent cities.
  • npc_compare_sources() compares a live build with the archive. For 2018 and 2019 the EIN sets agree to within 4 organizations a year, and revenue, expenses and assets agree for virtually every organization (net assets for 99.9%).
  • The archive now has one row per EIN and tax year. The SOI panel repeats about 0.3% of EIN-years (short-period returns after an accounting-period change, and repeats across extracts), which counted those organizations twice. npc_standardize() and npc_get_orgs() keep a real filing over an imputed row, then the latest source file, then the latest period end, the same filing the NCCS files keep. Existing archives are deduplicated when read; rebuilding is not needed.
  • Live builds have no fundraising fees, revocation fields or geocoded CBSA; those columns are NA, and CBSAs come from the county crosswalk.

Local archive and multi-year builds (Phase 2)

  • npc_build_metrics() builds every metric for any set of years, for CBSAs and counties and several resources at once, as a long table or as the wide tables of get_all_metrics(), optionally written to disk with a manifest of the build.
  • npc_build_archive() converts the SOI panel sample frame CSV once into a Parquet archive partitioned by year; npc_get_orgs() reads only the years requested. npc_standardize(), npc_archive_dir() and npc_archive_info() support it. Requires the arrow package.
  • New population data on fixed 2020 boundaries: pop_county and pop_cbsa (2000-2025) and the county-to-CBSA crosswalk cbsa_county_xwalk (2023 delineation), read with npc_get_population().
  • Metric tables now include a national row (GEO = "ALL", SUB = "ALL").
  • check_year_completeness() judges years against the typical count of substantial years, so a tail of nearly empty early years no longer hides incomplete ones.
  • Faster rollups with data.table grouping.
  • The live NCCS source and the registered and grassroots universes are planned; requesting them gives an informative error.

Metric fixes and tests (Phase 1)

  • All concentration metrics share one set of helpers and one API: geography, subsector, resource and year arguments, with SUB = "ALL" and GEO = "ALL" rollups.
  • get_scale_free_density() now fits count models (negative binomial by default, or Poisson) on a full market frame that includes markets with no organizations, keeps national rows out of the models, and reports the density index as observed / expected - 1. The original log-linear model is available as model = "loglinear".
  • get_kwoka() uses the standard Kwoka (1977) index, the sum of squared gaps between successive shares.
  • Single-organization markets get NHHI = 1, consistent with HHI, CRk and Kwoka.
  • New check_year_completeness(); get_all_metrics() drops incomplete years by default.
  • New dataset npo_panel_sample (Vermont 501(c)(3) filers, 2015-2019) for examples and tests.
  • testthat suite with hand-computed values for every metric.

Package cleanup (Phase 0)

  • npcompete builds and passes R CMD check: scripts moved out of R/, one definition per function, complete DESCRIPTION and NAMESPACE.
  • get_density(), get_density_small(), get_density_big(), get_density_commercial() and get_fundraising_efficiency() use the old NCCS core-file layout and are deprecated.
  • pkgdown site with the NODC pkgstyle template; MIT license.
